name: polymarket-smart-money
description: Polymarket Smart Money Dashboard — top trader position aggregator

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev" --names "API,UI" --prefix-colors "cyan,green"
scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm start" --names "API,UI" --prefix-colors "cyan,green"
